notes: Added Organize Pages with drag-and-drop widget placement and multi-page organization.
Added Advanced Notes to the Notes & Tasks widget, allowing you to mix text paragraphs and checkboxes in a single entry using Shift + Enter.
Added a Cleanup Data menu to Notes & Tasks settings for surgically clearing completed tasks, all tasks, all notes, or wiping everything.
Introduced the new Counters widget to track days since or until important events, habits, and recurring chores.
Introduced the new Progresses widget to track multi-step goals and projects with linear or free-form checklists, custom labels, and visual progress bars.
Added the new Golden accent color with a bright, shiny golden appearance.
Refined the Liquid Glass effects for a clearer, cleaner appearance with more subtle highlights and a more balanced glass look.
Updated the extension icon with a fresh new logo design.
Replaced the default toast notification system with a custom, design-system-aligned toaster that integrates seamlessly with the Liquid Glass UI.
Revamped Data Backup & Restore with improved performance and a clean new full-screen UI.
Exported backup files now include the local date and time in the filename for easier version tracking.
